text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (July 16, 2024) for 55 Triller Avenue

The Property Standards Committee - Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (July 16, 2024) for 55 Triller Avenue, Folder Number 24 181075 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to August 31, 2025 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
